fixed_exponent.clarification: alpha_H is the little-Holder regularity exponent and is unrelated to any model coupling.

fixed_domain_coordinates.reason: The moving radial endpoints are carried only by rho_s while tau fixes both regional domains to [0,1] and encodes even pole parity.

pole_regular_affine_chart.clarification: The chart is an affine parametrization of the frozen smooth-pole parity class; it is not a numerical initial-condition prescription.

little_holder_spaces.definition: h^{k,alpha_H}([0,1]) is the closure of C-infinity([0,1]) in the C^{k,alpha_H} norm.
little_holder_spaces.reason_for_little_holder: Smooth functions form a dense core, unlike the full big Holder space at fixed exponent.
little_holder_spaces.dense_embedding: X_prof is continuously and densely embedded in Z_prof through the common smooth core.
little_holder_spaces.Banach_algebra_use: h^{k,alpha_H} on the compact interval is used as a Banach algebra for the products and smooth exponential compositions appearing in M1.

augmented_parameter_space.space: P=R^5 x R_positive^2 x R with rho_N>0 and rho_S>0
augmented_parameter_space.model_shape_parameters: The six frozen M1 model-shape parameters are external coefficients and are not promoted to augmented BVP unknowns.
augmented_parameter_space.discrete_sector: N_F, N_sigma and m_sigma are fixed integer labels per operator instance.

conditions: all frozen active M1 parameter-domain conditions hold
admissible_open_set.openness: Strict positivity of rho_s and the compact-interval minimum of Lhat_s define an open subset in the declared Banach topology.
admissible_open_set.cap_radius: ell_s at tau=1 is strictly positive throughout U_adm.

definitions.F_ell_s: E_ell_s/ell_s with its continuous tau=0 extension
definitions.F_varphi_s: E_varphi_s/ell_s with its continuous tau=0 extension
definitions.F_gauge_s: E_gauge_s/sqrt(tau) with its continuous tau=0 extension

regularized_bulk_operator.smoothness: F_bulk is C-infinity as a Banach-space map on U_adm by multiplication, differentiation, inversion on the positive Lhat cone and smooth exponential composition.
regularized_bulk_operator.constraint_QA: C_rr/ell has a continuous tau=0 extension and remains a propagated QA channel rather than an additional target component.

cap_trace_operator.continuity: Gamma_cap:X_prof x P->R^14 is continuous because endpoint values and first derivatives are continuous traces on h^{2,alpha_H}, while the gauge value is a continuous trace on h^{1,alpha_H}.

constant_cap_function_consequences: R_scalar has principal derivative part delta_varphi_N_x+delta_varphi_S_x
no lambda_varphi or Z_sigma_varphi localized scalar source appears in M1
patch and global flux remain one residual under the frozen two-patch convention
nonlinear_boundary_map.not_evaluated: No numerical boundary vector is evaluated because no candidate M1 background exists.

full_nonlinear_operator.physical_solution_set: G^{-1}(0) is not shown to be nonempty.

linearized_boundary_trace_template.background_prerequisite: W_star must be a separately declared exact or controlled candidate satisfying G(W_star)=0 before numerical trace rank is admissible.

linearized_operator_template.boundedness: For every W_star in U_adm, L_star is a bounded linear map between the declared Banach spaces.
linearized_operator_template.bounded_map_closedness: Every bounded linear map X->Y has a closed graph; this limited closedness statement is proven once W_star is fixed.

density_and_closedness_audit.smooth_core: C-infinity parity-chart profiles are dense in X_prof and Z_prof by the little-Holder definition.
density_and_closedness_audit.clarification: Density and bounded-graph closedness do not imply Fredholmness, compact resolvent, index zero or invertibility.

prerequisites: freeze one candidate background W_star with provenance and residual tolerances
verify W_star lies in U_adm and satisfies the pole and cap traces
freeze the numerical representation of L_star without changing spaces or residual scaling
future_kernel_cokernel_protocol.kernel_test: Solve L_star*delta_W=0 and demonstrate dimension convergence across at least two independent discretizations.
future_kernel_cokernel_protocol.cokernel_test: Construct the dual or adjoint discretization compatible with the declared pairings and demonstrate cokernel-dimension convergence.
future_kernel_cokernel_protocol.index_test: Only after kernel and cokernel convergence may index=dim(kernel)-dim(cokernel) be reported.
future_kernel_cokernel_protocol.trace_test: Report singular spectrum of the parameter-augmented endpoint trace after eliminating the bulk linearized equations; a square count is insufficient.
future_kernel_cokernel_protocol.continuum_upgrade: A continuum Fredholm or implicit-function claim requires a separate theorem or controlled discretization-to-continuum argument.

The principal cap block does not prove invertibility of the full augmented trace.
